commentkeyword.description: Official MCP server for CommentKeyword: create and manage Instagram comment-to-DM keyword automations ("comment GUIDE and I'll DM you the link") through Instagram's official API. Dependency-free Node stdio server, pinned to release v0.2.0. Tools: create_keyword, update_keyword, list_keywords, get_keyword, delete_keyword, list_agents. Create a token at https://commentkeyword.com/settings?tab=api (API access is included on the Free plan). Docs: https://commentkeyword.com/instagram-mcp-server
